name: drone-works
description: A trustworthy operational flight record for professional drone teams.

scripts.contract:generate: corepack pnpm --filter @drone-works/contracts --filter @drone-works/database --parallel run build && node --import tsx apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts && openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi/openapi.json -o packages/contracts/src/generated/openapi.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts/dev scripts/verify .github/workflows/verify.yml eslint.config.mjs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts/dev scripts/verify .github/workflows/verify.yml eslint.config.mjs package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts/dev scripts/verify eslint.config.mjs
scripts.test:authorization: corepack pnpm --filter @drone-works/database run build && corepack pnpm --filter @drone-works/api run test:authorization
scripts.test:contract: corepack pnpm --filter @drone-works/api run test:contract && corepack pnpm contract:check && corepack pnpm boundaries
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm boundaries && corepack pnpm privacy:check
